errors: Theorem 1's identities (7)–(9) are, for trace-class operators on Hilbert space, exactly Lidskii's theorem (1959). The claim that 'one reduces to the case u hermitian positive, where it is easy' is a genuine gap. Neither the eigenvalues nor the determinant of u are controlled by those of |u|. Hadamard factorization only gives det(1+zu) = e^{az}∏(1+zλ_i); proving a = 0 is the hard content of Lidskii's theorem. The ℓ^1 claim for the eigenvalues is correct (Weyl 1949).

Formula (9) is described as following 'again from (8) applied to Λu'. This is circular: (9) is the case n=1 of (8), and (8) for Λ^n u is equivalent to (9) for Λ^n u. Applying (8) to Λ^n u proves nothing new without an independent argument.

Minor: the normalization (1/n! inside u1∧…∧un, but none in Λ^n u = u∧…∧u) must be fixed consistently for (1) and (5) to hold simultaneously. The text leaves it implicit, and Grothendieck himself flags the notation as ambiguous.

ideas.what: Fredholm coefficients as traces of exterior powers, and the bound |α_n(u)| ≤ ||u||_1^n/n! via ||Λ^n u||_1 = e_n(singular values)
ideas.modern_name: Fredholm determinant via exterior powers (Simon's 'Trace ideals' approach)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (La théorie de Fredholm, 1956); later systematized by B. Simon (1977, Trace Ideals)
ideas.where_published: La théorie de Fredholm, Bull. SMF 84 (1956); Produits tensoriels topologiques (1955)

ideas.usually_credited_to: Folklore; appears in Simon, Trace Ideals

ideas.what: For trace-class u, det(1+zu) = ∏(1+zλ_i) and Tr u = Σλ_i
Norm inequality for wedge products of exterior powers: ||Λ^p u ∧ Λ^q v||_1 ≤ [p!q!/(p+q)!] e_p(ρ(u)) e_q(ρ(v)), used to bound Λ^m(u+v)
ideas.modern_name: Mixed exterior-power estimate underlying the Seiler–Simon / Rotfel'd determinant inequality
ideas.usually_credited_to: Seiler–Simon (1975) for det(1+|A+B|) ≤ det(1+|A|)det(1+|B|); Rotfel'd (1969), Thompson (1976) for related concave-function trace inequalities

missed.claim: Prop. 2 is the key lemma, completed on the next page, for a 1953 proof of det(1+|u+v|) ≤ det(1+|u|)det(1+|v|). It also gives the stronger coefficient-wise inequality e_m(ρ(u+v)) ≤ Σ_p e_p(ρ(u)) e_{m-p}(ρ(v)). The determinant inequality is usually credited to Seiler–Simon (1975), with related results by Rotfel'd/Thompson. I am not sure it appears in Grothendieck's 1956 Fredholm paper.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It would predate the standard attribution of the subadditivity of log det(1+|·|) by about 20 years. It also gives a short exterior-algebra proof of the elementary-symmetric refinement.

missed.claim: In 1953 Grothendieck asserted the Lidskii trace formula for trace-class operators as 'easy' by reduction to positive operators. This reduction is invalid; the result was proved only by Lidskii in 1959. The page documents that the problem was underestimated before it was solved.
missed.quote: Pour la preuve, on est ramené au cas où u est hermitien positif, où c'est facile.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Historical: it clarifies the status of the trace = sum of eigenvalues question in Grothendieck's Fredholm program, and why his published Banach-space results needed order-2/3 nuclearity.

deep.surprise_reason: Mostly routine Fredholm-determinant estimates later published or standard. Two points stand out. First, there is an early, apparently unpublished exterior-power lemma leading to the Seiler–Simon determinant inequality and a coefficient-wise refinement. Second, Lidskii's theorem is mistakenly claimed to be easy.
